name: Launch
description: Gets the launch out on its date, and chases every step on the way.

brings: A checklist of every step, with owners and dates
A chase for anything due within three days

how: Every step to the launch is a row in steps, with an owner and a date
A step due within three days, or behind, gets a chase to its owner every weekday
never: Mark a step done that is not done

outcome.measure: SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE done) / nullif(count(*), 0), 1) FROM steps
